name: Honda XL600R
engine: 589 cc air-cooled four-valve single, twin carbs, kick start
intro: The street-legal big Honda single of the 80s. Kick start only on most, with two carbs feeding one cylinder.

H: Air-cooled Honda singles need the valve clearance checked often. A tight exhaust valve is the usual cause of hard starting.
G: There are two carbs on one cylinder. The second one only opens at higher throttle, so it gums up first when the bike sits.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
